p: give thanks unto the LORD: Because God by creating David king, showed his mercy toward his afflicted Church, the prophet not only thanks God himself, but exhorts all the people to do the same.
distress: We are here taught that the more that troubles oppress us, the more ought we to be instant in prayer.
man do unto me: Being exalted to this estate, he assured himself to have man ever to be his enemy. Yet he did not doubt that God would maintain him, because he had placed him.
in man: He shows that he had trusted in vain if he had put his confidence in man, to have been preferred to the kingdom and therefore he put his trust in God and obtained.
Thou hast thrust sore at me: He notes Saul his chief enemy.
song: In that he was delivered, it came not from himself, not from the power of man, but only from God's favour, therefore he will praise him.
voice of rejoicing and salvation is: He promises both to render graces himself, and to cause others to do the same, because in his person the Church was restored.
declare the works of the LORD: So that all, that are both far and near, may see his mighty power.
gates of righteousness: He wills the doors of the tabernacle to be opened, that he may declare his thankful mind.
refused is become the head stone: Though Saul and the chief powers refused me to be king, yet God has preferred me above them all.
day which the LORD hath made: In which God has shown chiefly his mercy, by appointing me king and delivering his Church.
O LORD: The people pray for the prosperity of David's kingdom, who was the figure of Christ.
we have blessed you out of: Who are the priests, and have the charge of it, as in Nu 6:23.
light: Because he has restored us from darkness to light, we will offer sacrifices and praises to him.
